note: PLACEHOLDER PRICES - not any vendor's pricing, and never checked against one. They are nonzero so the estimator has something to demonstrate, and unverified so the guarded API adapter REFUSES to spend against this file (verified=false; see docs/API_ADAPTER.md). To use it for real: copy it, replace every number with the provider's current published price per 1,000 tokens, set verified to true, and set priced_at to the date you checked. The model ids are configuration too - real Claude identifiers, shown as examples of the key format, not as a claim about what any of them costs.
